# Brew

> Brew is a single-user RSS and newsletter reader with deterministic rules, daily Brew issues, reader-app sync and scoped agent tools. Node stores the library in local SQLite; the Cloudflare target uses D1 and private R2 storage behind owner Access.

Official source: https://github.com/tanzir71/brew
Interactive canned demo: https://tanzir71.github.io/brew/demo/

## Product facts

- One person, their own instance; no hosted multi-tenant Brew service or telemetry.
- Run locally on Node or deploy your own Cloudflare instance with npx brew-reader deploy cloudflare (Node 22.12+ for the installer).
- The Node process must be running for scheduled fetching; the Cloudflare target uses minute cron invocations.
- Private newsletters use optional IMAP/provider webhook setup on Node or Email Routing on Cloudflare.
- Compose offers source sections, previews, schedules and optional configured email/webhook delivery.
- Node backup means stopping Brew and copying data/brew.db; Cloudflare deployment and resource guidance is in the repository's docs/cloudflare-install.md.
- OPML import/export is supported.
- A Brew is an immutable daily snapshot assembled from user-configured sections and rules.
- Google Reader/Fever clients use a generated app password. MCP tools use scoped tokens and reviewed actions with Undo; experimental WebMCP stays opt-in.
- The public demo uses canned data and does not fetch feeds or persist data.
